parameters: test value: constant observed pressure (u_a is fed by a pressure_observer in a network); needs the proposed config fix

invariants.description: R_T follows the CellML piecewise law: 1 Pa s m^-3 if check <= 0, check if 0 < check <= 1e13, 1e13 above (NB values in (0, 1) pass through unclamped)
physical bound: terminal flows stay below 1e-3 m3/s (60 L/min, far above any single terminal) - fails when the learned output goes negative and R_T drops to the 1 Pa s m^-3 floor
the three membership functions (negative / zero / positive pressure error) form a partition of unity: u2 + u5 + u8 = 1

with a constant observed pressure u_a the pressure error is constant, so d(aa_i)/dt = error d(cc_i)/dt gives the first integral aa_i - 100 = error (cc_i - 100) (both start at 100), checked for i = 2, 5, 8
invariants.expr: (np.max(np.abs((aa2 - 100) - error*(cc2 - 100))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(aa2 - 100)))) & (np.max(np.abs((aa5 - 100) - error*(cc5 - 100))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(aa5 - 100)))) & (np.max(np.abs((aa8 - 100) - error*(cc8 - 100))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(aa8 - 100))))

invariants.description: pressure error is pressure_d - u_a with the harness value u_a = 11000 Pa
volume balance: q(t) - q(t0) = integral of (v - v_T) dt from t0 = 10 ms (after the sub-ms inertial start-up transient, which the output grid cannot resolve), trapezoid on the output grid
pressure law: u_C = (q - q_us)/C_T and u = u_C + u_ext + (0.01/C_T)(v - v_T)
flow-fraction error uses the terminal's own inflow: error_flow_percent = 100 (BFF_ASL - v/meanflow_4dflow)

bc_sweep.rationale: Pressures span 45-135 mmHg inlet / target and 0-15 mmHg venous & external pressure; C_T spans small-terminal to large-outlet compliances around the Boileau2015 iliac value (3.7e-10); meanflow spans ~0.3x-3x the benchmark mean inflow; BFF_ASL spans 10-90 %; I_T two decades around the placeholder. These are claimed working ranges once the config fix is applied.

baseline.reason: controller-driven boundary condition: its target values (pressure_d, BFF_ASL, meanflow_4dflow) are patient inputs; validation belongs to the closed-loop network that uses it (e.g. controlled terminals of the Boileau2015 bifurcation/ADAN56 benchmarks, whose Windkessel pressures could be compared)

calibrate.note: not_applicable: the controller itself identifies R_T online; nothing to calibrate in isolation
